question: What completes the heroic eightfold set used in bathing and worship?
premises: The self is included in the heroic set.
That self is well established after all affliction of conceptual thought has been shaken off.
This eightfold set is to be honored in bathing, worship, and related rites by heroic practitioners.
inference: The heroic eightfold set culminates in the self, free of all conceptual affliction, and this set is to be honored by heroes in bathing and worship.
plain_english: The self, well established with all the affliction of conceptual thought shaken off, completes the heroic group of eight forms to be honored in bathing, worship, and so on.
